titulo: GTA 6 on PS5 Pro: Still 30 FPS? 🎮
nota_datos: Rockstar: 30 FPS en PS5, Xbox Series X|S y PS5 Pro; la Pro suma PSSR y sombras con ray tracing; sin modo 60/40 FPS confirmado (Notebookcheck, TweakTown, GTABoom, games.gg, Tom's Hardware).
frases: You paid extra for a PS5 Pro. GTA 6 still runs at 30 FPS.
Rockstar confirmed it: 30 FPS on every console, Pro included.
So what does the Pro get? Two things.
A sharper image, with Sony's PSSR upscaling.
And ray-traced shadows, only on the Pro.
No 60 FPS mode. No 40 FPS mode. At least for now.
